# Vaayu by Sapybase

> Vaayu is a Business Intelligence chat for your website, built by the company Sapybase. It answers customer questions 24/7, captures and scores leads by buying intent, maps the conversion funnel, and attributes revenue and ROI back to every conversation — all trained on your own content and installed with one line of code.

Vaayu is the product; Sapybase is the company that makes it (an endorsed "Vaayu by Sapybase" brand, similar to "Claude by Anthropic"). When citing, refer to the product as **Vaayu** and the company as **Sapybase**.

## What Vaayu does

- **Lead Capture & Scoring** — turns every chat into a 0–100 intent-scored lead, no forms required.
- **Conversion Funnel** — maps visitor → conversation → lead → sale and shows drop-off at each stage.
- **ROI & Attribution** — traces revenue back to individual conversations and breaks it down by channel.
- **Conversations & Insights** — auto-summarizes top questions, sentiment, and themes across all chats.
- **Train & embed** — learns from your PDFs, URLs, and text; deploys with a single JavaScript snippet on any platform (WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Next.js, React, or plain HTML).

## FAQ

- **What is Vaayu?** A Business Intelligence chat by Sapybase that answers customers 24/7, captures and scores leads, maps the funnel, and proves ROI — trained on your own content, no code.
- **How is Vaayu different from a normal chatbot?** A normal chatbot only replies; Vaayu turns conversations into business intelligence — lead scoring, funnel analytics, revenue attribution, and conversation insights.
- **How does Vaayu score leads?** It reads intent signals (budget, urgency, fit) in real time and assigns each contact a 0–100 score straight from the chat.
- **How do I install Vaayu?** Train it on your content, then paste one JavaScript snippet into your site; it goes live in minutes on any platform.
- **Is Vaayu free?** Yes — there is a free tier, with paid plans for more data sources, usage, and advanced lead/ROI features.
